title: FlexLine Credit Review and the Borrower's Personal Loans
content:
In a credit review of a FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit line, the loan cut is added to the review cut by the borrower's Larkspur Personal Loans: an active personal loan when none of the borrower's active personal loans has an amount past due of 0.00 adds 0.10; an active personal loan with an amount past due of 0.00 and one or more personal-loan late fees in the last 12 months adds 0.05; any other borrower adds nothing.

**Records read.** The borrower's Personal Loans — each loan's status and amount past due — and the late-fee entries booked on any of the borrower's personal loans, dated after the same day of the month 12 months before the review date. The cut is a share of the credit limit (0.10 is 10 percentage points).

## Decision table

| Borrower's personal loans | Personal-loan late fees in the last 12 months | Added to the review cut |
|---|---|---|
| at least one active loan, and every active loan has an amount past due above 0.00 | any | 0.10 |
| at least one active loan with an amount past due of 0.00 | one or more | 0.05 |
| at least one active loan with an amount past due of 0.00 | none | nothing |
| no active personal loan | any | nothing |

*Hypothetical case:* a borrower with two active personal loans, one current and one with an amount past due, and one personal-loan late fee seven months ago, falls in the second row and adds 0.05.
